messages:
samir: Hey team — quick ask. CS needs a contractor (cindy) temporary access to our Amplitude org to investigate a billing-related stream of events. Can we approve with controls?

irene: What's the minimum scope they need? project-level or org-level? Any user-identifiable props they need to see (email, phone, full_user_id)? :eyes:

samir: Just session/event-level timeline for ~10 user IDs we gave them. They want to view events and run funnels. We do NOT want email or raw_email prop surfaced. We do need the user_id (internal) for correlation but can we pseudonymize?

morgan: For the incident, CS needs to reproduce sequences. If we remove user_id they can't correlate across devices. Suggest: give them a project role with 'Viewer' + 'Event Segmentation' and a temporary mapping table where IDs are replaced with a random token. They only need it for a 72h window.

ashley: From infra side: we can create a temp API key scoped to the project and attach an expiration timestamp. Amplitude supports role-based project permissions; avoid org-admin. Also enable query-only access (no data export) and disable raw event downloads.

irene: Policy checklist: 1) no PII props in viewable fields; 2) access limited to named contractor and manager approval; 3) 72h max; 4) audit log entry + ticket in #vendors. If any raw_email exists in events we must redact first.

samir: There are a couple of events with a prop named 'contact_email' — that's PII. We can run a quick redact job to remove that prop for the affected time range. I'll coordinate with infra.

ashley: If you run a redact, run it on a copied dataset or create a read-only project snapshot. I'll block exports and snapshots from copying email fields.

irene: Also require SSO-only sign-in for the contractor (no shared keys). If they don't have SSO, we provision a temporary account with forced MFA and expiration.

sec-bot: Automated check: contractor cindy is not in SCIM. Manual approval required by cindy's manager and sec.ember@redwood.com.

samir: Manager approval: @morgan approved via DM. Irene, can you sign off on the redaction + scoped access?

irene: OK from security if: redact contact_email, expire access 72h, API key disabled post-window, exports off, SSO/MFA enforced, and we log actions to audit. Please file an access request in /ops/access and include the list of 10 user IDs masked with tokens. :lock:

morgan: Filing the access request now and adding the masked IDs. I'll ping once infra creates the scoped API key.

samir: Thanks everyone — I'll coordinate the redact job and update this thread when ready.

ashley: Key created with expiration 2026-04-03T14:00:00Z, exports disabled. Sent SSO invite to cindy@contractors.redwood (one-time).

irene: Closing on my side once audit logs show cindy's first sign-in and no email props visible. Keep me posted.

samir: Will do — marking this as in-progress. :white_check_mark:
